name: angaria
description: Create, sign and download Turkish e-Arşiv invoices through the Angaria Mac app
long_description: Angaria is a paid Mac app for Turkish e-Arşiv invoicing on GİB's e-Arşiv Portal. While the app is open, it serves an MCP server on this Mac. This bundle holds angaria-mcp, a small stdio program that forwards each request to that server. It needs the Angaria app installed and open, with a license or the 7-day free trial. Signing, deleting and changing company details work only when the user turns on "Ajanlar onaylayabilir ve silebilir" in the app, and signing always needs the SMS code GİB sends to the user's phone.

author.name: Vinena Yazılım ve Tasarım Ltd. Şti.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: Lists invoices between two dates (31 days at most), filtered by status and recipient.

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Gets an invoice's recipient, lines and totals, or GİB's own view of the invoice.

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Creates an unsigned draft invoice with the same rules as the app's New invoice form.

tools.name: duplicate_invoice
tools.description: Creates a new draft from an existing invoice, dated today.

tools.name: download_invoice
tools.description: Saves the Angaria PDF, the e-Arşiv PDF or GİB's ZIP file to your Downloads folder.

tools.name: request_signing_sms
tools.description: Asks GİB to send an SMS code to your phone so drafts can be signed.

tools.name: sign_invoices
tools.description: Signs drafts with the SMS code you give the agent. A signed invoice is final.

tools.name: delete_draft
tools.description: Deletes an unsigned draft from GİB. Never touches signed invoices.

tools.name: list_customers
tools.description: Lists saved customers and their invoice defaults.

tools.name: get_customer
tools.description: Gets a customer's details and invoice defaults.

tools.name: create_customer
tools.description: Saves a new customer.

tools.name: update_customer
tools.description: Changes a customer's details or invoice defaults.

tools.name: delete_customer
tools.description: Deletes a saved customer. Invoices you already issued do not change.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Lists saved services with their prices, currencies and VAT rates.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Gets a service's price, unit and VAT rate.

tools.name: create_service
tools.description: Saves a new service.

tools.name: update_service
tools.description: Changes a service's name, price or VAT rate.

tools.name: delete_service
tools.description: Deletes a saved service. Invoices you already issued do not change.

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: Lists the companies in Angaria and which one is selected.

tools.name: get_company_details
tools.description: Gets the company and bank details printed on the PDF, and the PDF design.

tools.name: update_company_details
tools.description: Changes the company and bank details printed on the PDF, including the IBAN.

tools.name: rename_company
tools.description: Changes the company name shown in Angaria's company list.

tools.name: set_company_logo
tools.description: Replaces the PDF logo with an image file on your Mac, or removes it.

tools.name: get_exchange_rate
tools.description: Gets the Turkish central bank (TCMB) buying rate for an invoice date.

tools.name: check_gib_connection
tools.description: Logs in to GİB with the saved user code, then logs out. The password never goes to the agent.

tools.name: lookup_taxpayer
tools.description: Gets the registered name and tax office for a Turkish tax ID (VKN or TCKN) from GİB.

tools.name: close_gib_session
tools.description: Closes a session that is still open on the e-Arşiv Portal.

tools.name: scan_gib_import
tools.description: Finds customers and services to save from your signed invoices.

tools.name: apply_gib_import
tools.description: Saves the customers and services you chose from the scan. Never changes saved ones.

tools.name: get_app_settings
tools.description: Gets the theme, the color palette and Angaria's version.

tools.name: update_app_settings
tools.description: Changes the theme or the color palette.
